claim: The US runs bioweapons labs in Ukraine
source: UN Security Council briefings Mar 2022 (UN: no evidence of a bioweapons program); AP and Reuters fact checks 2022
note: Real Ukrainian public-health labs with US support exist; the weapons claim is the false part.
first_official: Mar 2022: Russian Defense Ministry briefings and Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Zakharova; amplified by Chinese Foreign Ministry

claim: The Bucha killings were staged or faked
source: UN OHCHR reports 2022; Maxar satellite imagery; NYT visual investigation 2022
first_official: Apr 3 2022: Russian Defense Ministry called the images a staged provocation

claim: The Mariupol maternity hospital or theatre strike was staged or done by Ukraine
source: AP investigation 2022; OSCE Moscow Mechanism report 2022
first_official: Mar 2022: Russian Embassy in the UK posts and Foreign Minister Lavrov said the hospital was an Azov base

claim: Zelensky is a cocaine or drug addict
source: Reuters and AFP fact checks 2022-2024 (doctored videos)
first_official: Doctored videos circulated on social media from 2022; later echoed by Russian officials

claim: Zelensky or his wife bought yachts, mansions, a Bugatti or Cartier jewelry with aid money
source: BBC Verify, AFP and Reuters fact checks 2023-2024 (fabricated documents, tied to Russian network Storm-1516)
first_official: 2023-2024: fabricated documents and fake news sites tied to the Russian network Storm-1516, laundered through proxy sites

claim: Ukraine sells Western weapons to Hamas, cartels or the black market
source: Pentagon end-use monitoring and DoD Inspector General reports 2023-2024 (no evidence of significant diversion); fact checks on Hamas claim Oct 2023
note: Small-scale smuggling worries were real early on; the Hamas and cartel versions are fabricated.
first_official: Oct 2023: fake video styled as a BBC/Bellingcat report; former president Medvedev suggested Ukraine's weapons reached Hamas

claim: Ukraine's government is a Nazi regime
source: 2019 election results (far-right coalition about 2%); Zelensky is Jewish; Holocaust scholars' open letter 2022
note: Far-right units such as Azov's origins are a real topic; the claim that the state is Nazi-run is the false part. Bare "denazification" was dropped from the pattern in Oct 2026: it mostly matched WWII history talk.
first_official: Feb 24 2022: Putin's invasion speech named 'denazification' as a war aim

claim: Ukraine committed genocide in the Donbas
source: ICJ provisional measures order Mar 2022 (no evidence presented); OHCHR casualty data 2014-2021
first_official: Feb 2022: Putin said Donbas residents faced genocide; repeated in the Feb 24 speech

claim: US aid to Ukraine is money laundering or mostly stolen
source: DoD Inspector General and USAID OIG oversight reports 2023-2025 (no evidence of large-scale theft)
note: Ukrainian corruption cases are real and prosecuted; the claim that the aid program is a laundering scheme is the misleading part.
first_official: Social media and proxy sites, echoed by Russian officials

claim: NATO expansion provoked or caused the invasion
note: A contested argument with serious defenders and critics. Tracked for narrative alignment only, never counted as misinformation.
first_official: Long-running Putin theme (Munich speech 2007); central to his Feb 2022 justification

claim: The 2014 Maidan revolution was a US or CIA coup
note: Mostly rejected by historians, but involves real events (the Nuland call). Tracked as framing, not counted as misinformation.
first_official: 2014: Russian government framed the Maidan revolution as a Western-backed coup

claim: Zelensky is illegitimate because elections were postponed
note: Ukraine's constitution bars elections under martial law; the legitimacy argument is contested. Tracked as framing.
first_official: May 2024: Putin said Zelensky's legitimacy ended with his original term

claim: A video showed mail-in ballots for Trump being destroyed in Bucks County, Pennsylvania (Oct 2024)
source: FBI and ODNI joint statement Oct 25 2024 (fabricated, Russian influence actors); Bucks County Board of Elections

claim: Haitian immigrants were filmed voting multiple times in Georgia (Oct 2024)
source: Georgia Secretary of State Oct 31 2024; FBI and ODNI statement Nov 1 2024 (Russian influence actors)

claim: Kamala Harris paralyzed a girl in a 2011 hit-and-run in San Francisco
source: Microsoft Threat Analysis Center Sept 2024 (Storm-1516); fact checks by AFP and others
note: Staged video with an actor, laundered through a fake local news site.

claim: USAID paid celebrities such as Ben Stiller and Angelina Jolie to visit Ukraine
source: Fact checks Feb 2025 (fake E! News video; E! said it never made it); researchers tied it to Storm-1516

claim: Germany secretly agreed to bring in about 1.9 million Kenyan workers
source: VIGINUM Storm-1516 report 2025; German government denial
note: Real Germany-Kenya labour agreement exists; the numbers and secrecy were fabricated.

claim: The EU's Democracy Shield and digital rules make it an authoritarian censorship regime
note: A recurring Russian theme per the EEAS 4th report, also a mainstream free-speech criticism. Tracked as framing, never counted as misinformation.
first_official: EEAS 4th threat report (Mar 2026) records it as a 2025 Russian narrative
